name: Jafel Filho
event: UFC Fight Night: Adesanya vs. Magomedov
summary: A Brazilian flyweight from Nova Uniao (17-5, age 33). He is 4-3 in the UFC: three R1 submissions (Barez, Osbourne, Carpenter) and decision losses to Allan Nascimento and Cody Durden (April).

how_they_fight.Striking: Secondary; five knockouts in our data.
how_they_fight.Grappling: A back-taker: eleven submissions, eight in R1.
how_they_fight.Defense: Never knocked out; submitted twice in R3.
how_they_fight.Pace & cardio: Loses on the cards when he can't finish early.

concerns: Two straight losses on the cards to grinders
keys_to_beat: Keep it standing or win the grappling exchanges

sources.author: Mike Heck
sources.title: UFC Saudi Arabia: Several new bouts added to Israel Adesanya vs. Shara Magomedov fight card
